scope: Document-backed checks for the declared Windows 11, Intel integrated-graphics Latitude 5440 configuration, one WD22TB4 with its 180 W adapter and up to two direct DisplayPort P2422H displays at 1920×1080/60 Hz. Not physical testing, live stock, prices, or general model-name compatibility.

sources.title: Dell Latitude 5440 — external ports
sources.facts: Two Thunderbolt 4 / DisplayPort Alt Mode / power-delivery ports.

sources.title: Dell Latitude 5440 — external display support
sources.facts: Intel UHD and Iris Xe configurations list three external displays with the internal panel enabled. This app reviews only up to two.

sources.title: Dell WD22TB4 — display resolution table
sources.facts: Dual direct DisplayPort supports FHD/60 even at non-Thunderbolt HBR2. Thunderbolt HBR2 supports dual QHD/60. HDMI and MFDP cannot be used together. Drivers, EDID and OS affect results.

sources.title: Dell WD22TB4 — product specifications
sources.facts: 130 W delivery to Dell systems with the 180 W AC adapter; attached 0.8 m host cable.

sources.title: Dell P2422H — product specifications
sources.facts: 23.8-inch viewable display; 1920×1080/60 Hz; DisplayPort 1.2 and HDMI inputs; listed package has one 1.8 m DisplayPort cable. Listing currently says unavailable; supplier availability is not inferred.
